column1: JBIDE-24542,Improve intaller/central tests to be possible to start them automatically,"There are some tests which have to be started manually because they require path to installer package which varies for each build, so they can't be triggered by timer.

JBIDE-22653,Scale Pod: should get warned when scaling to 0,"The scale to... menu lets you scale to any number of replicas, but you can't go down to 0.
The webconsoles allows it, albeit with a big warning: ""Are you sure you want to scale deploymentname to 0 replicas? This will stop all pods for the deployment.""
My take is we should have the same behavior in eclipse",Feature Request,Major,1,2,21,0,3,0,1,33.09228728009259,33.09228728009259,20.9996803125,6.0,6.0,1
